text_blocks.speaker: Lethal Shooter
text_blocks.text: I gotta give the disclaimer first. It might be ugly, but the consistency of it is what you can't deal with. Lethal Shooter is one of the greatest in the world, there's no denying that. My issue with basketball is I've broken every one of my fingers at least twice on each hand. So when I'm catching the ball, I'm trying to catch it in my palms and not on my fingers. My fingers getting stubbed is excruciating, and so my whole shooting form and everything is tailored to that. I can still get my shot off. You're not even thinking I'm shooting, there's no shooting motion taking place. I'm dribbling it here and shooting it here too.

quotes.speaker: Lethal Shooter
quotes.summary_phrase: Lethal Shooter explains his coaching approach using real-life relatability
quotes.excerpt: I try to relate it to what the person does in their everyday life.
quotes.quote: Everybody is different. I try to relate it to what the person does in their everyday life. So last night, I did the Rizzler. When we got to the court, at first he was overthinking. I said, listen man, you got to relax. It's the same way as when you're doing content or it's the same way when you have to do something for school. So what I do is I try to relate it to what the person does in their everyday life.

quotes.speaker: Carmelo Anthony
quotes.summary_phrase: Carmelo Anthony and Lethal Shooter discuss the cathartic nature of coaching
quotes.excerpt: to me, stuff like this is cathartic.

text_blocks.speaker: Carmelo Anthony
text_blocks.text: Does this type of stuff fulfill you? Does it feel? Because like when you say like when you're going through a lot of trauma, there's a lot of stuff going on, to me, stuff like this is cathartic.

text_blocks.speaker: Lethal Shooter
text_blocks.text: Yeah. Like teaching Justin Bieber how to shoot. A lot of our friends who might have that same issue that they didn't make it to where they wanted, they don't have people talking to them on podcasts or hearing that, hey man, you can still shoot the ball. So they get deeper and deeper in their brain. So that might lead to alcoholism or crack or heroin. With me, I don't drink, smoke, nothing. But I'm just saying, doing stuff like this, it does make my spirit feel good to be around good energy.

quotes.speaker: Lethal Shooter
quotes.summary_phrase: Lethal Shooter on his training approach with NBA players
quotes.excerpt: I don't train all NBA guys together. You know why? Because you're not him.

text_blocks.speaker: Lethal Shooter
text_blocks.text: I don't train all NBA guys together. You know why? Because you're not him. Him, I gotta train him ISO. I gotta put three guys on him. He gotta go off the dribble, go right, pull up, pump fake, pump fake, shot. He gotta come down in transition, split, pull up. You just gotta come off screens. You just gotta go in a lane, work on your left hand, right hand, floater. So with my training, it's not like that.

text_blocks.speaker: Carmelo Anthony
text_blocks.text: See, don't let them do that. See, don't let them do that. You do gotta work on that footwork.

text_blocks.speaker: Lethal Shooter
text_blocks.text: I'm not trying to water down your game. You might be him. But I'm saying, this is our Michael Jordan and this is our hero. He's got a jacket, bro. What are you talking about? I just said, but you see how they try to make it, you might be him. Get you with the wire, bro. I'm not trying to disrespect you. No, work on the love, bro. I'm working on the love. You good, you good.

quotes.speaker: Lethal Shooter
quotes.summary_phrase: Lethal Shooter on his training process with NBA players
quotes.excerpt: When I take people full-time, it's a dramatic change.
quotes.quote: When I take people full-time, it's a dramatic change. When I was with Grant Williams full-time, he was number two in the league in three-point percentage. When I was with Bobby Portis full-time, he was number two. When I was with Jaylen Brown, I've been with him for the last four years. When I was with AD, he won a ring. When I was with KCP, he was top three in the league. At the time I had Avery Bradley. I'm blessed to be the Nike master trainer. I was the director of Nike Academy for five years with Sam Jones. And in that same breath, I can train a Carmelo at 2:00, and then at 4:00 I can train a Fabulous. You know what I mean? Because my brain, I know how to cut it on and cut it off.

quotes.speaker: Carmelo Anthony
quotes.summary_phrase: Carmelo Anthony's praise for Lethal Shooter's career path
quotes.excerpt: For you to find your lane in the adjacency of the actual sport and to be successful.
quotes.quote: For you to find your lane in the adjacency of the actual sport and to be successful and to create a whole another brand and business off of that game of basketball, most people would have folded. Most people would have stayed back in the hood. Most people would have not knowing what they would have did. You kept that going, you didn't let that deter you. So from where you come from, DMV, DC, that whole area, keep putting on for that, keep being a positive role model to those kids and keep helping these people shoot, man. Young, old, rappers, singers, actors, whoever it may be.
